SELECT c.name, c.ticker, e.label AS trial, e.external_id, sd.url, sd.published_at
FROM companies c
JOIN entities e ON e.entity_type='clinical_trial' AND e.label ILIKE '%mRNA-4157%' AND e.label ILIKE '%KEYNOTE%'
LEFT JOIN source_documents sd ON sd.provider='clinicaltrials' AND sd.provider_id='NCT03897881' AND sd.company_id=c.id
WHERE c.ticker='MRNA';
" 2>&1
docker exec infra-postgres-1 psql -U cala -d cala -c "
SELECT c.name, c.ticker, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.entity_type='clinical_trial') AS trials,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.entity_type='paper') AS papers,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.entity_type='news') AS news
FROM companies c
JOIN entities ce ON ce.entity_type='company' AND ce.label=c.name
JOIN relationships r ON r.to_entity_id=ce.id OR r.from_entity_id=ce.id
JOIN entities e ON e.id = CASE WHEN r.to_entity_id=ce.id THEN r.from_entity_id ELSE r.to_entity_id END
WHERE c.ticker='MRNA'
GROUP BY c.name, c.ticker;
" 2>&1
docker exec infra-postgres-1 psql -U cala -d cala -c "
SELECT sd.provider, sd.provider_id, left(coalesce(sd.normalized_text,''), 100) AS excerpt, sd.url, sd.published_at

WHERE c.ticker='MRNA'
ORDER BY sd.published_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 6;
" 2>&1
